company.name: Sakneen
company.shortDescription: Sakneen provides a fast, easy, and convenient way to find and buy a home.
company.description: Sakneen is building an online real estate platform that will make it easier for developers, agents, and individuals to buy and sell properties mainly homes.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that displays real estate inventory on a map synchronized with CRM data, enabling sales teams to manage availability and sales processes digitally.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Sales Tools for Real Estate Developers

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows instant creation of customer offers for properties, eliminating manual compilation and speeding up the sales process.
productsAndServices.name: One-Click Offer Generation

productsAndServices.description: A service that synchronizes property inventory data with developers' systems to ensure up-to-date availability information for sales teams and customers.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Inventory Synchronization

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows sales teams to accept reservations and payments for property units from local and international clients through the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Online Payment Enablement

productsAndServices.description: Pricing plans and service tiers that accommodate real estate developers managing single or multiple projects with varying inventory sizes and feature needs.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Project Management Plans
